clue.text: Sail off to the lowest point, one now back from north Cyprus

definitions.text: one now back from north Cyprus

indicators.note: off here means gone wrong or out of order, so the letters of sail are rearranged

parts.note: the nadir is the lowest point, opposite the zenith

explanation.surface: A sailor heads out to the bottom of the sea, while someone returns home from northern Cyprus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' makes ASIL from the letters of 'Sail'. Asil Nadir, the Polly Peck tycoon, fled to northern Cyprus in 1993 and came back to Britain to face trial in 2010.
explanation.definitionFit: The businessman Asil Nadir spent seventeen years as a fugitive in northern Cyprus before returning to stand trial in London.

clue.text: Dumps drugs in me, disguised by lots of berries and bread

indicators.note: something disguised has its appearance changed, so the letters of the four words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tips narcotics into a person, masking them with heaps of fruit and loaves.
explanation.definitionFit: These British desserts are bowls lined with bread and packed with soft red berries, then turned out once set.

clue.text: Relative to one taking drugs, a scene with nothing to be said

definitions.text: scene with nothing to be said

parts.note: a gran, or grandmother, is a relative
a doper is someone who takes drugs

explanation.surface: A family member describes an addict, with a scene in which nobody speaks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is only a link. Grand opera is sung throughout with no spoken dialogue, which the definition describes.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of serious opera has every line sung, with no spoken passages at all, unlike operetta.

clue.text: Native American doctor gets the bird

parts.note: MO is Medical Officer, a military doctor
a hawk is a bird of prey

explanation.surface: A tribal physician catches a bird of prey.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mohawk are an Iroquois people of New York State and Canada.

clue.text: See 11
Love to write 20 that's spaced out

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
to pen is to write

explanation.surface: A lover sets about composing an order with its parts spread out.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 is ORDER: OPEN ORDER is the military formation with gaps between the ranks, so the answer is the word that, put before ORDER, makes it spaced out.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops in an open formation are spread with wide gaps between them, the opposite of close formation.

clue.text: Songster of happiness perished in lake

definitions.meaning: the ... of happiness is a traditional symbol of joy and a songbird
Donald Campbell died on Coniston Water in 1967 in his speedboat of that name

explanation.surface: A bird known for joyful song dies in a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is an allusion: Campbell's hydroplane crashed during a water speed record attempt on the Lake District lake Coniston Water.
explanation.definitionFit: A North American thrush is the songbird of joy, and also the name of the record-breaking boat that sank with Donald Campbell.

clue.text: See 25
Make it all right with a person often reverted to

parts.note: to square something is to settle it or make it right
one means a person, as in one should

explanation.surface: Someone settles matters with an individual they often go back to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link. The definition leans on the phrase back to square one: the starting point one returns to.
explanation.definitionFit: Being back at the very start after a setback is the idiom here, so it is the place people keep returning.

clue.text: 1 26 made this parrot use its beak

definitions.meaning: the tycoon at 1 down and 26 built up the ... group in the 1980s
The stock name for a parrot

explanation.surface: A businessman teaches a parrot to use its beak.
explanation.walkthrough: 1 26 is ASIL NADIR, whose company Polly Peck collapsed in 1990. The second definition reads the name as a pet parrot pecking.
explanation.definitionFit: Polly Peck International was the FTSE conglomerate run by Nadir, and a parrot named Polly could peck.

clue.text: Mongrel menu that is formed for 19 across, one of 2 19 down

indicators.note: formed means shaped anew, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A mixed-breed dog's menu is shaped into a dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: 19 across is PIE and 2 19 down is two PUDDINGS read as 'two puddings': the answer goes before PIE to make one of two meringue-topped desserts in the puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: Lemon curd topped with whipped egg white baked crisp makes the classic pie filling referred to here.

clue.text: Dressing for food (including ground nut tops)

indicators.note: including means holding within, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: aliment is a formal word for food or nourishment

indicators.note: tops are the first letters of the words ground and nut

explanation.surface: A salad dressing for a dish that contains crushed nut toppings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dressing' is the military sense, lining troops up straight, not a salad dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: In drill, dressing the ranks means bringing soldiers into a straight line.

clue.text: Thus love in division is abandoned

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the word for division

parts.note: a fork is a point where a road divides
so means thus
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Love falls apart in a split, and so is deserted.
explanation.definitionFit: To have deserted or given up something is the past tense meaning here.

clue.text: Was manager in football club given money?

indicators.note: in puts the manager's verb inside the club's letters

parts.note: ran means managed or was in charge

explanation.surface: Did the boss of a soccer team get paid?
explanation.definitionFit: The currency of France before the euro, still used in Switzerland, is a unit of money.

clue.text: 20 to say nothing when trying to be sick

definitions.meaning: 20 is ORDER; a court's ... order forbids someone to speak about something
retching, heaving as if about to vomit

explanation.surface: An order to stay silent while someone is retching.
explanation.walkthrough: A gagging order is a British term for an injunction preventing publication or disclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: Retching is an attempt to throw up, and an injunction against speaking is this kind of order.

clue.text: Fashionable character, the coarse swallowing the sheepish

indicators.note: swallowing means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: gross means coarse or vulgar
ovine means of or like sheep

explanation.surface: A trendy figure who is crude gulps down the timid one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheepish' means bashful in the surface but is the literal sheep-like adjective here.
explanation.definitionFit: Being hip and trendy is the quality of the slang adjective groovy, so this noun is a fashionable character.

clue.text: Police the lake?

definitions.meaning: the ... Siochana is the police force of Ireland
Lake ... is the largest lake in Italy

explanation.definitionFit: Irish police officers are known as the Garda, and an Italian lake shares the name.

clue.text: Request to be served one of 19 down's just so story?

parts.note: 19 down is PUDDINGS, and apple pie is one such pudding
an order is a request to be served in a restaurant

explanation.surface: Asking for one of the puddings, a tale of things being just as they should be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'story?' nods to Kipling's Just So Stories. The order is reversed in the answer: the pudding comes before the request.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in perfect neatness, everything in its place, is said to be in this kind of order.

clue.text: Send maybe surreptitious message from G2?

definitions.meaning: to slip a written message to someone secretly, as in a classroom
G2 is the Guardian's features section, which runs a column of this name

explanation.surface: Sending a secret message, perhaps, from a newspaper supplement.
explanation.definitionFit: Schoolchildren slip folded paper messages, and the Guardian's G2 has a long-running explainer column of the same name.

clue.text: See 17
See 2
See 17
Accompaniment to 17 19 across, thrown when just with 19 across

definitions.meaning: 17 19 across is APPLE PIE, often served with a yellow sweet sauce
with only PIE after it, it names the slapstick dessert flung in a comedian's face

explanation.surface: A sauce served alongside a dessert, which gets hurled when it comes only with the pastry.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is the slapstick custard pie, thrown in clowns' faces.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet egg-and-milk sauce is the usual British partner to apple pie, and the slapstick projectile is this kind of pie.

clue.text: Dancer, friend bearing 5 eggs for singular 5 19 down

indicators.note: bearing means carrying, so the friend holds the number inside

parts.note: pal means friend
V is the Roman numeral for five
ova is the Latin plural for eggs

explanation.surface: A ballerina whose companion carries five eggs to make a meringue dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: The last part, 'for singular 5 19 down', gives a second definition: one meringue (5) pudding (19 down), named after Anna Pavlova.
explanation.definitionFit: Anna Pavlova was a famous Russian ballerina, and the meringue dessert was named in her honour.

clue.text: Wade with spade or blade

definitions.meaning: a small spade-shaped implement used for stirring or digging
the flat blade of an oar

explanation.surface: Walk through shallow water carrying a shovel or knife.
explanation.definitionFit: To walk through shallow water barefoot is to dabble, and a short oar or flat broad-bladed implement shares the name.

clue.text: Peculiar issue more likely than not

parts.note: odd means peculiar
a son is issue, meaning offspring

explanation.surface: A strange child is probably going to happen.
explanation.definitionFit: A betting phrase for a favourite with better than even chances of winning.

clue.text: Armed to the teeth: "God at work" wasn't true

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of shepherds
op is short for opus, a musical work
lied means told an untruth

explanation.surface: A heavily armed man claims a deity was busy, but that was false.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at' is only a link between the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A panoply is a full suit of armour, so someone so equipped is completely armed.

clue.text: See 10
Energy dispersed in point of play

indicators.note: in puts the rearranged letters inside the point abbreviation
dispersed means scattered, so the letters of energy are rearranged

explanation.surface: Power spread around within the key moment of a drama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'point' looks like the aim of the play, but it is just the abbreviation PT; 'in' then sets the scrambled letters between its two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibsen wrote this verse drama about a Norwegian wanderer, with music by Grieg.

clue.text: See 1
Rocky part of sail

definitions.meaning: a ridge of rock near the sea's surface
a section of sail that can be rolled up to reduce its area in strong wind

explanation.definitionFit: A rocky ridge below the waterline, and a section of sail that can be tied in, share the name.

clue.text: Smart girl copper gets bond

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
a tie is a bond

explanation.surface: A clever young woman's policeman gets attached.
explanation.definitionFit: An attractive young woman is called by this informal endearment, smart meaning stylish.

clue.text: Inside problem every way left outside

indicators.note: outside means the word for left goes around the other pieces

parts.note: gone means left or departed
all means every
St is short for Street, a way

explanation.surface: A domestic difficulty, every road out of bounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Inside problem' is literal: a hard deposit forming inside the body.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard concretion formed within the gall bladder is a medical complaint deep inside the body.
